'''Cucumbers''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons, and the fruit is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] cucumber vines for their ''fruit''.
